entries: Manila (Quiapo): millions follow the Black Nazarene through the streets in a procession that can last a day. Roads around Quiapo close.
Kalibo, Aklan: dancers with soot-blackened faces and tribal costumes fill the streets; the festivities run all week up to this Sunday.
Cebu City: the street-dancing grand parade for the Santo Niño, after a week of processions.
Iloilo City: the tribe dance competition and street parades.
